paragraphs.en: With fireballs in his hands, the Cauldron Group's David Duckworth sets magical potions ablaze.
paragraphs.zh: Cauldron酒吧的大卫·达克沃斯手里拿着火球，点燃了魔法药水。

paragraphs.en: So all the drinks that we have on offer at the Cauldron, the key thing to know about them is that they're all fully interactive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在Cauldron酒吧提供的所有饮品，它们都是可以发生反应的。

paragraphs.en: So you are able to interact with the various ingredients, and using molecular mixology and science behind the drinks.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以使各种成分相互作用，利用饮料背后的分子调酒技术和科学。

paragraphs.en: You are able to make your drinks do something that you've probably never seen a drink do before.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以让饮料做一些以前从未见过的事情。

paragraphs.en: Gathered around crystal balls in Cauldron in a dark, magical room, sit witches and wizards learning new and delicious magic.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个黑暗的魔法房间里，女巫和男巫们围坐在Cauldron酒吧的水晶球旁，学习新奇而美妙的魔法。

paragraphs.en: So this is a potion making class. When people come in, they get a robe, they get a magic wand, that's one of our custom magic wand that actually works.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一堂药剂制作课。人们进店的时候，会得到一件长袍，一根魔杖，这是我们定制的一根真正能够起作用的魔杖。

paragraphs.en: And they learn to brew molecular potions, which are molecular cocktails, where we employ chemistry in the drink making process.
paragraphs.zh: 他们学习调制分子药剂，也就是分子鸡尾酒，我们在调酒过程中运用化学原理。

paragraphs.en: When customers arrive, they receive their magician's cloak and a magic wand they use to pour themselves a drink from a beheaded magical creature.
paragraphs.zh: 当顾客到达店里时，他们会收到魔术师斗篷和一根魔杖，他们用这根魔杖从一只被斩首的魔法生物那里给自己倒一杯饮料。

paragraphs.en: The magic wand powered by the sorcery known as the Internet of Things also operates taps, turns on lights and unlocks doors at the Cauldron.
paragraphs.zh: 这根由被称为物联网的魔法驱动的魔杖，还在Cauldron酒吧操控水龙头、开灯和开门。

paragraphs.en: So our mission is to bring fantasy and magic to life with science, technology and design,
paragraphs.zh: 我们的使命是用科学、技术和设计将幻想和魔法变为现实，

paragraphs.en: and to allow people to step into the imagined world, to their childhood in a really authentic way.
paragraphs.zh: 让人们以一种真实的方式踏入想象中的世界，重温他们的童年。

paragraphs.en: Cortland, once a high school reading teacher, says that career progressed into this one,
paragraphs.zh: 科特兰曾是一名高中阅读教师，他表示这份职业逐渐发展成了现在的工作——

paragraphs.en: where he teaches adults to interact with literature, and the STEM curriculum of science, technology, engineering and mathematics.
paragraphs.zh: 教导成年人如何与文学作品互动，以及教授科学、技术、工程和数学课程。

paragraphs.en: The experience, he says, takes some adults back in time.
paragraphs.zh: 他说，这种体验让一些成年人回到了过去。

paragraphs.en: We just googled fun things to do in London. It was one of the things that came up.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刚刚在谷歌上搜索了伦敦有趣的活动，就出现了这家酒吧。

paragraphs.en: Owners say fantasy fans of all ages appreciate a place that brings magic to life.
paragraphs.zh: 酒吧业主们说，各个年龄段的奇幻爱好者都很喜欢这个能让魔法照进现实的地方。

paragraphs.en: But junior witches and wizards beware, the Cauldron only shares the dark arts with those 18 years and older.
paragraphs.zh: 但是年轻的巫师们要当心， Cauldron酒吧只与18岁及以上的巫师分享黑魔法。
